I1.quote: Searched text and all four figures for a gravimetric, volumetric (Sieverts) or flow measurement of the amount of H2 taken up (wt%, mmol/g, isotherm); none found. Only QENS/INS neutron spectra of condensed H2 are reported.

I5.quote: The effects of confining molecular hydrogen within carbon nanohorns are studied via high-resolution quasielastic and inelastic neutron spectroscopies.

notes: Experimental neutron-scattering letter (IRIS, ISIS) on H2 adsorbed on commercial SWNHs (MER Corporation). H2 loading is described only as 'normal H2 (75% ortho, 25% para) was condensed at T = 25 K and P = 1 bar into an annular-geometry aluminum cell' (main, p. 3, Section II); no amount of H2 taken up is measured or reported, and the figures plot QENS/INS intensities and widths only. Not theoretical and not electrochemical, so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated per the instruction. The only surface area is a cited literature value ('surface areas approaching 1500 m2g-1 [5]', main, p. 2, Section I), not one for the sample used; I4 is not assessed because I1 fails. Document is primary research (not a review or abstract-only); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF; no duplicate-data statement.
